# MomJunction

> > MomJunction is a comprehensive parenting and pregnancy resource platform providing expert-reviewed advice on baby names, pregnancy, child health, and family wellness.

The site features medical reviewers including OB-GYNs, pediatricians, and pediatric specialists, alongside expert panel members specializing in numerology, astrology, lactation consulting, nutrition, and relationship coaching. Content is reviewed by healthcare professionals from institutions including Vardhman Mahavir Medical College, Safdarjung Hospital, and Star Hospitals across India, UK, and US.

## Key Topics

- Pregnancy and childbirth
- Baby names and numerology
- Pediatric health and development
- Obstetrics and gynecology
- Lactation and infant feeding
- Parenting advice
- Child nutrition
- Relationship coaching
- Medical review board
- Vedic astrology
- Healthcare professionals
- High-risk pregnancy
- Baby care
- Family wellness
